note: Catalogue capture for the held tier-2 operator manual TM 9-2320-272-10 / Air Force TO 36A12-1C-441 (M939/M939A1/M939A2 series, Change 2 of September 2004). It holds the M923A2 cargo dropside truck as a wheeled entry. The manual publishes the identity, the dimensions, the chassis dimensions, the empty weight and the payload, the Cummins engine ratings as brake horsepower, the automatic transmission range count, the tyre size code, the tyre pressures, the maximum safe operating speeds and the fording depth. It names no manufacturer, publishes no curb weight as a named state, no operating weight, no net power with a stated basis, no engine torque, no engine displacement and no transmission model designation, so the entry is not runtime-ready and emits no runtime row. Every dimension comes from a table that prints both the inch and the centimetre figure. The entry records the published centimetre figure converted to millimetres (a decimal shift) and the published kilogram figure where the table prints one.
